import time

def timer():
    start_time = time.time()
    print("计时器已启动")

            hours, remainder = divmod(elapsed_time, 3600)
            minutes, seconds = divmod(remainder, 60)
            print(f"\r时间: {int(hours):02d}:{int(minutes):02d}:{int(seconds):02d}", end="", flush=True)
            time.sleep(1)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n计时器已停止")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    timer()

import time
import threading

def timer():
    start_time = time.time()
    print("计时器已启动")
    
    while True:
        elapsed_time = time.time() - start_time
        hours, remainder = divmod(elapsed_time, 3600)
        minutes, seconds = divmod(remainder, 60)
        print(f"\r时间: {int(hours):02d}:{int(minutes):02d}:{int(seconds):02d}", end="", flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    timer_thread = threading.Thread(target=timer)
    timer_thread.start()
    
    try:
        while True:
